verse.verse_1: When the Event (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) befalls.
verse.verse_2: And there can be no denying of its befalling.
verse.verse_3: It will bring low (some); (and others) it will exalt;
verse.verse_4: When the earth will be shaken with a terrible shake.
verse.verse_5: And the mountains will be powdered to dust.
verse.verse_6: So that they will become floating dust particles.
verse.verse_7: And you (all) will be in three kinds (i.e. separate groups).
verse.verse_8: So those on the Right Hand (i.e. those who will be given their Records in their right hands), Who will be those on the Right Hand? (As a respect for them, because they will enter Paradise).
verse.verse_9: And those on the Left Hand (i.e. those who will be given their Record in their left hands), Who will be those on the Left Hand? (As a disgrace for them, because they will enter Hell).
verse.verse_10: And those foremost [(in Islamic Faith of Monotheism and in performing righteous deeds) in the life of this world on the very first call for to embrace Islam,] will be foremost (in Paradise).
verse.verse_11: These will be those nearest to Allah.
verse.verse_13: A multitude of those (foremost) will be from the first generations (who embraced Islam).
verse.verse_14: And a few of those (foremost) will be from the later time (generations).
verse.verse_15: (They will be) on thrones woven with gold and precious stones,
verse.verse_17: They will be served by immortal boys,
verse.verse_18: With cups, and jugs, and a glass from the flowing wine,
verse.verse_19: Wherefrom they will get neither any aching of the head, nor any intoxication.
verse.verse_20: And fruit; that they may choose.
verse.verse_21: And the flesh of fowls that they desire.
verse.verse_22: And (there will be) Houris (fair females) with wide, lovely eyes (as wives for the pious),
verse.verse_24: A reward for what they used to do.
verse.verse_25: No Laghw (dirty, false, evil vain talk) will they hear therein, nor any sinful speech (like backbiting, etc.).
verse.verse_26: But only the saying of: Salam!, Salam! (greetings with peace)!
verse.verse_27: And those on the Right Hand, Who will be those on the Right Hand?
verse.verse_29: Among Talh (banana-trees) with fruits piled one above another,
verse.verse_33: Whose season is not limited, and their supply will not be cut off,
verse.verse_34: And on couches or thrones, raised high.
verse.verse_35: Verily, We have created them (maidens) of special creation.
verse.verse_37: Loving (their husbands only), equal in age.
verse.verse_38: For those on the Right Hand.
verse.verse_39: A multitude of those (on the Right Hand) will be from the first generation (who embraced Islam).
verse.verse_40: And a multitude of those (on the Right Hand) will be from the later times (generations).
verse.verse_41: And those on the Left Hand Who will be those on the Left Hand?
verse.verse_42: In fierce hot wind and boiling water,
verse.verse_45: Verily, before that, they indulged in luxury,
verse.verse_46: And were persisting in great sin (joining partners in worship along with Allah, committing murders and other crimes, etc.)
verse.verse_47: And they used to say: "When we die and become dust and bones, shall we then indeed be resurrected?
verse.verse_49: Say (O Muhammad SAW): "(Yes) verily, those of old, and those of later times.
verse.verse_50: "All will surely be gathered together for appointed Meeting of a known Day.
verse.verse_51: "Then moreover, verily, you the erring-ones, the deniers (of Resurrection)!
verse.verse_52: "You verily will eat of the trees of Zaqqum.
verse.verse_53: "Then you will fill your bellies therewith,
verse.verse_54: "And drink boiling water on top of it,
verse.verse_55: "So you will drink (that) like thirsty camels!"
verse.verse_56: That will be their entertainment on the Day of Recompense!
verse.verse_57: We created you, then why do you believe not?
verse.verse_58: Then tell Me (about) the human semen that you emit.
verse.verse_59: Is it you who create it (i.e. make this semen into a perfect human being), or are We the Creator?
verse.verse_60: We have decreed death to you all, and We are not unable,
verse.verse_61: To transfigure you and create you in (forms) that you know not.
verse.verse_62: And indeed, you have already known the first form of creation (i.e. the creation of Adam), why then do you not remember or take heed?
verse.verse_63: Tell Me! The seed that you sow in the ground.
verse.verse_64: Is it you that make it grow, or are We the Grower?
verse.verse_65: Were it Our Will, We could crumble it to dry pieces, and you would be regretful (or left in wonderment).
verse.verse_66: (Saying): "We are indeed Mughramun (i.e. ruined or lost the money without any profit, or punished by the loss of all that we spend for cultivation, etc.)! [See Tafsir Al-Qurtubi, Vol. 17, Page 219]
verse.verse_68: Tell Me! The water that you drink.
verse.verse_69: Is it you who cause it from the rainclouds to come down, or are We the Causer of it to come down?
verse.verse_70: If We willed, We verily could make it salt (and undrinkable), why then do you not give thanks (to Allah)?
verse.verse_71: Tell Me! The fire which you kindle,
verse.verse_72: Is it you who made the tree thereof to grow, or are We the Grower?
verse.verse_73: We have made it a Reminder (for the Hell-fire, in the Hereafter); and an article of use for the travellers (and all the others, in this world).
verse.verse_74: Then glorify with praises the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.
verse.verse_75: So I swear by Mawaqi (setting or the mansions, etc.) of the stars (they traverse).
verse.verse_76: And verily, that is indeed a great oath, if you but know.
verse.verse_77: That (this) is indeed an honourable recital (the Noble Quran).
verse.verse_78: In a Book well-guarded (with Allah in the heaven i.e. Al-Lauh Al-Mahfuz).
verse.verse_79: Which (that Book with Allah) none can touch but the purified (i.e. the angels).
verse.verse_80: A Revelation (this Quran) from the Lord of the 'Alamin (mankind, jinns and all that exists).
verse.verse_81: Is it such a talk (this Quran) that you (disbelievers) deny?
verse.verse_82: And instead (of thanking Allah) for the provision He gives you, on the contrary, you deny Him (by disbelief)!
verse.verse_83: Then why do you not (intervene) when (the soul of a dying person) reaches the throat?
verse.verse_84: And you at the moment are looking on,
verse.verse_85: But We (i.e. Our angels who take the soul) are nearer to him than you, but you see not, [Tafsir At-Tabari, Vol. 27, Page 209]
verse.verse_86: Then why do you not, if you are exempt from the reckoning and recompense (punishment, etc.)
verse.verse_87: Bring back the soul (to its body), if you are truthful?
verse.verse_88: Then, if he (the dying person) be of the Muqarrabun (those brought near to Allah),
verse.verse_89: (There is for him) rest and provision, and a Garden of delights (Paradise).
verse.verse_90: And if he (the dying person) be of those on the Right Hand,
verse.verse_91: Then there is safety and peace (from the Punishment of Allah) for (you as you are from) those on the Right Hand.
verse.verse_92: But if he (the dying person) be of the denying (of the Resurrection), the erring (away from the Right Path of Islamic Monotheism),
verse.verse_93: Then for him is entertainment with boiling water.
verse.verse_95: Verily, this! This is an absolute Truth with certainty.
verse.verse_96: So glorify with praises the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.
